quotes: During 2025, the U.S. Administration has imposed significant tariffs on goods imported, ranging from a 10% baseline to much higher rates on a variety of imports.
In fiscal 2025, less than 15% of our cost of goods sold was from products or materials sourced from outside the United States, primarily from China, Brazil and Mexico.
Inflation moderated in fiscal 2024 and into the first half of fiscal 2025 before increasing in the second half of fiscal 2025 due primarily to the increasing impact of tariffs.

risks.basis: Stated in P1 Item 1 Business and P2 Risk Factors.

Home Depot, our second largest customer, represented approximately 16% of total net sales in fiscal 2025 and 17% in fiscal 2024.
Together with Costco, Lowe's and Amazon these major retailers represented approximately 54% of total net sales in fiscal 2025 and 2024.

risks.claim: Prolonged grass seed oversupply since fiscal 2023 has depressed market prices, resulting in a $15–$20 million inventory write-down in fiscal 2024 and ongoing margin pressure on the Pennington and Kaytee businesses.
quotes: Beginning in fiscal 2023, there has been a prolonged oversupply of grass seed, which has resulted in a significant decline in market prices.
As a result of this decline, in fiscal 2024, we incurred an approximately $15-$20 million charge to write-down the value of our grass seed inventory.
In fiscal 2025, grass seed market prices remained low although the oversupply of grass seed is beginning to moderate.
